types.dialog: Hello traveler. Search your surroundings well. Many times you will find lost objects from other travelers who passed through here.
Hi. It is said that there is a merchant here. Look for it, it will be very useful for your journey.
Hi, human. I'll give you some advice, choose which battles to fight. Many times it is better to escape from the strongest creatures until you have good equipment.
Hello human. You will find chests in many places. It will be useful to have a key at hand. They could contain very useful things inside.
I've been watching you, and you don't look good. Take these gold coins.
Again you here. I will give you something that will help you in your adventure.
Hello again. I have a potion stored here that could be useful.
Hello Friend. You look a bit disoriented. I will help you with this fog.
I have found a key here. You may find it useful in your adventure.

chest.dialog: You find an old chest. This looks closed. If you got a key maybe you can open it and see what treasure it contains.
chest.dialogWithKey: You find an old chest. It is likely that you can open it with the key you have in your inventory. What do you want to do?
